videos.title: Die Missetäter
videos.description: Der Bankangestellte Morán aus Buenos Aires fasst einen Plan, um der Eintönigkeit seines Lebens zu entfliehen: Er will genug Geld für einen beschaulichen Ruhestand stehlen, sich dann stellen und seine Haftstrafe absitzen, während sein Komplize das Geld verwahrt. Als ein Ermittler Druck auf ihn ausübt, flieht sein Komplize Román mit dem Geld in eine abgelegene ländliche Idylle. Dort begegnet er einer geheimnisvollen Frau, die sein Leben für immer verändern wird.

videos.title: Stacey Dooley
videos.description: Rehab centres are treating some of their youngest-ever and most physically damaged addicts, and ketamine has been their drug of choice. Stacey Dooley gains rare access to a rehab in Stockport and gets to know former users. Many are in chronic pain, and one young man needs bladder reconstruction surgery. Over four months, she follows them through recovery, relationships, setbacks and celebrations.

videos.title: The Young Offenders
videos.description: A not-so-clever plan to earn some extra cash backfires, bringing the lads head-to-head with Sergeant Healy, who has been hot on their heels for some time and is determined to catch them up to no good. They also may have been caught in the act by Principal Walsh's two daughters, Siobhán and Linda, so the lads need to turn on the charm to persuade the girls not to spill the beans, which only serves to further irritate Principal Walsh.

videos.title: The Young Offenders
videos.description: Conor and Jock's friendships with principal Walsh's daughters Linda and Siobhan intensify, causing awkward tension between the lads, the principal, and the girls themselves. Conor and Jock crash a Walsh family barbecue, and principal Walsh's wife Orla is intent on her husband giving the lads a chance: they can't be all that bad, can they?

videos.title: The Young Offenders
videos.description: There's only one thing left for Conor and Jock to do to get Linda and Siobhan to really fall for them: spend a whole day together on a beautiful adventure. A sick day from school is the only way they can do this, leading to various difficulties.

videos.title: Long Story Short
videos.description: Coming-of-age comedy drama set in the annual paranormal festival of a postindustrial town known as the 'Roswell of South Wales'. A shy 17-year-old outsider is marked for 'abduction' as part of the town's terrifying tradition. He must evade capture and make it through the night, navigating love, friendship and events that are beyond explanation.

videos.title: Doctor Who
